class Person:
    def __init__(self, aName, aId, aAge):
        self._cachedHashCode = None
        self._canSetId = True
        self._canSetName = True
        self._name = aName
        self._id = aId
        self._age = aAge

    def setName(self, aName):
        if not self._canSetName:
            return False
        self._name = aName
        return True

    def setId(self, aId):
        if not self._canSetId:
            return False
        self._id = aId
        return True

    def setAge(self, aAge):
        self._age = aAge
        return True

    def getName(self):
        return self._name

    def getId(self):
        return self._id

    def getAge(self):
        return self._age

    def __eq__(self, obj):
        if type(obj) is not type(self):
            return NotImplemented
        return (self.getId(), self.getName()) == (obj.getId(), obj.getName())

    def __hash__(self):
        if self._cachedHashCode is None:
            self._cachedHashCode = hash((self.getId(), self.getName()))
            self._canSetId = False
            self._canSetName = False
        return self._cachedHashCode

    def equals(self, obj):
        return self == obj

    def delete(self):
        pass

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "id:" + str(self.getId()) + ","
                + "name:" + str(self.getName()) + ","
                + "age:" + str(self.getAge())
                + "]")
